name: Engine v1 with Lex's two research previews on the Bitcoin sleeve
author: Lex (the previews and their thresholds: channel divergence, late-cycle signals). Rule form and the 0.80 threshold on the three non-concentration gauges: Claude, 2026-10-08.
description: As E1, but Bitcoin moves on the mean of the composite, the channel-divergence preview and the late-cycle preview (each 0..1, high = risk-on), so a broken channel or a saturated late cycle pulls Bitcoin down even when the composite is loud. Ports prototype R2's two tilts (down one notch, halfway to neutral) to the sleeve-signal form.
